messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["wolf", "crab", "lobster"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "The creature has the overall shape of a large gray wolf standing in three-quarter profile facing right, with dense gray and white wolf fur on its head, ears, neck ruff, chest, lower legs and tail tuft, but most of its body is covered by a dark gray-black segmented hard shell like a lobster carapace. The shell forms overlapping plates over the back, neck, top of the head, outer legs, and top of the tail, with a pale cream segmented underside visible on the belly and inner legs. Its two front legs are thick jointed armored limbs ending in large crab-like pincers that rest on the ground, while its two hind legs are thinner and end in wolf-like paws with black claws, and it has a bushy wolf tail with armor on top.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "gray and white furry wolf head with long muzzle, black nose and amber eyes", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the creature facing right"}, {"looks_like": "pointed furry wolf ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head, one partly covered by shell"}, {"looks_like": "thick long gray and white wolf fur ruff", "part": "mane", "where": "around the neck and chest below the head"}, {"looks_like": "dark gray-black segmented hard shell like a lobster carapace with overlapping plates and scalloped edges", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the back from behind the head to the hips, the neck, the top of the head, and the outer legs"}, {"looks_like": "pale cream segmented soft underside", "part": "belly", "where": "along the underside of the torso between the legs"}, {"looks_like": "thick jointed armored limbs with dark outer segments", "part": "front legs", "where": "under the chest at the front of the body supporting the creature"}, {"looks_like": "large dark crab-like pincers with pitted surface and black tips", "part": "front feet", "where": "at the ends of the front legs touching the ground"}, {"looks_like": "thinner jointed legs with dark outer armor and pale inner segments", "part": "hind legs", "where": "under the hips at the rear of the body"}, {"looks_like": "pale furry wolf paws with black claws", "part": "hind feet", "where": "at the ends of the hind legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "bushy gray wolf fur tuft with dark segmented armor on top", "part": "tail", "where": "extending down from the rear of the body"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
